verdict.rationale: Missive documents rule-based automation ('Up to 1000 rules') and API/MCP access that could act across many items, plus a bulk auto-archive list feature, but there is no direct evidence of a bulk-select/bulk-action UI or bulk API endpoint for acting on many conversations/contacts at once. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-action UI documentation, bulk API/webhook examples, and independent confirmation of scale-limits for automation across many items.
